organization.name: SPUR — San Francisco Bay Area Planning and Urban Research Association

unit: One marginal $100,000 unrestricted gift; hypothetical allocation, no verified offer

budget.meaning: Includes shared research, education, coordination, fundraising and administration once. Marginal allocation judgments, not historical program shares.

ranking.bayResult: Bay including SF; not additive to SF result

duration.housingMeaning: Housing home-year inputs are already discounted integrals of the attached finite calendar schedules; do not multiply them by duration or discount a second time.
duration.transitMeaning: Useful service-hour inputs are discounted aggregates of explicit years1–5 schedules; no further five-year multiplier. Trips/400 are recurrent-use-equivalent rider-years, not calendar duration.
duration.heatMeaning: Effective discounted mortality-impact years include ramp, catch-up and lag. Conditional survival QALYs per death are judgments inherited from component; not perpetual treatment benefit.

definitions.housingContribution: Combined gift-versus-no-gift contribution includes funding displacement, implementation failure and collaborator credit; no second probability factor.
definitions.housingUtility: Wholly judgmental net health-state utility. Direct and nonoccupant benefit components must not duplicate the same housing-state gain; distinct benefits for a shared person may coexist.
definitions.transitContribution: Combined net gift contribution; no further attribution multiplier.
definitions.transitHealth: Net access/activity/injury judgment among changed recurrent rider-years. Deduplicate housing-related travel/health benefits, not every person who also benefits from housing.
definitions.heat: Inherited conditional bridge, not source-calibrated gift dose-response. Fraction scaled proportionally from prior component only as planning sensitivity.
definitions.unquantified: Governance/economic budget $15,000 retained but health contribution set to zero as partial-accounting convention, not proof of no welfare or harm.
definitions.donorHarm: Independent net SF/restBay harm outside already-net shared benefit priors; diagnostic amounts not observed.

formulas.transit: serviceHours * contribution * marginalTrips / tripsPerRiderYear * healthFraction * netQalyPerChangedRiderYear
formulas.heatBay: regionalExposureFraction * implementationProbability * attribution * effectiveYears * modeledRegionalDeaths * qalyPerDeath
formulas.netGeography: housing + transit + heat - donorSpecificHarm, separately SF/restBay; Bay = SF + restBay
formulas.cost: One full $100,000 donor budget; ratio 10*cost/Q iff Q>0, else null
formulas.resourceStress: Add $1,000,000 net induced resources once; not complete societal CEA or empirically priced implementation

limitations: All physical-output and unspecified health priors are analyst judgments, not inferred from spending shares.
Housing conditional scopes are unverified; permits and adopted rules do not prove financially feasible completions.
SF subset is geographic accounting, not guarantee SF net benefit <= total Bay when other places experience harm.
Deduplicate cross-channel health benefits/exposures and partner credit, not all shared people; governance enabling these outputs earns no second credit.
Do not infer contemporary SPUR food-program delivery after 2024 fiscal sponsor transfer.
Public/private induced construction, transit, appliance and implementation resources unpriced; favorable donor-only threshold fragile.
No generic GDP, births, innovation or all-city-population health multiplier.
SF/restBay labels encode an unverified health-residence allocation; neither project nor service location determines beneficiary residence.
All finite annual exposure schedules are illustrative decompositions of fixed integrated inputs, not forecasts; no numeric central improvement was made.

geography.basis: Explicit beneficiary-residence allocation prior, not infrastructure-location inference
geography.shareEvidence: Judgment; not observed commuter, migration, rent-catchment or household-residence data
geography.legacyFieldMeaning: SF/restBay homeYears and serviceHours are benefit-equivalent exposure cells assigned to resident groups. Their labels do not verify where a building stands or a vehicle operates. Geographic project scopes in v1 prose were illustrative, not independently established.
geography.crossBorderRule: A later project-location to beneficiary-residence matrix may allocate SF infrastructure effects to non-SF residents and vice versa. Current 25/75 allocation preserves existing totals; all-Bay scope still excludes unmodeled out-of-region effects.
geography.heatAllocation: Separate scenario-specific sfHealthShare inherited as an explicit health-residence prior, not equipment location.

verification.checks: 36 finite schedule integral checks plus105 existing-output comparisons; nine scenarios recomputed from inputs; old seven remain numerically unchanged within float tolerance
